info.title: Motor Condition Prediction API
info.description:
Research prototype: classifies **recorded motor condition** (class labels) from sensor readings.

* A prediction is a **predicted condition class, not a confirmed machine failure**.
* Scores are model outputs, **not calibrated probabilities**.
* Results flagged `demonstration_only` must not be used for operational decisions.

get.summary: List the model inputs, in the order the model expects
Download an empty CSV template with the correct columns

post.summary: Check a CSV file without predicting or storing anything
Predict the condition class for ONE set of sensor readings
Predict the condition class for every record in an uploaded CSV
Assess ONE motor from manually entered readings, get recommendations, and save the result

motor_id.title: Motor Id
motor_id.description: Motor reference (letters, digits, . _ -). New IDs are allowed if they match this pattern.

measured_at.title: Measured At
measured_at.description: When the reading was taken (ISO 8601). Required for assessments.

equipment_description.title: Equipment Description
equipment_description.description: Optional name or description of the equipment.

recorded_by.title: Recorded By
recorded_by.description: Optional free-text name or initials. NOT verified: the API has no user login.

readings.title: Readings
readings.description: One numeric value per model input, keyed by feature name (see GET /api/features). Text, booleans, NaN and infinity are rejected.

AssessmentRequest.title: AssessmentRequest
AssessmentRequest.description: A manual motor assessment. The same strict checks and preprocessing as CSV rows are applied to `readings`.

saved.title: Saved
saved.description: True only after the database confirmed the save.

recommendations_regenerated.title: Recommendations Regenerated
recommendations_regenerated.description: True when an older record had no stored recommendations and they were rebuilt from the stored condition.
